nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $K$ a field with $F$ a $K$-algebra. The adele ring $\mathcal{A}_F$ of $F/K$ is the restricted product of copies of $F$ indexed by the places $P$ of $F/K$, with respect to their valuation rings $\mathcal{O}_P$ and the cofinite filter: its elements are the families $\alpha = (\alpha_P)_P$ with $\alpha_P \in F$ for every place $P$ and $\alpha_P \in \mathcal{O}_P$ for all but finitely many $P$.…
nodes.title: Adele ring

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field and $F$ a function field over $K$, that is, a finite extension of the rational function field $K(t)$. If the genus of $F/K$ is at least $2$, then $F/K$ has only finitely many places of degree one, that is, places $P$ whose residue field (the quotient of the valuation ring of $P$ by its maximal ideal) has dimension $1$ over $K$.
nodes.title: Faltings' theorem (Mordell conjecture)

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a function field over a field $K$, that is, a finite extension of the rational function field $K(t)$. For every $x \in F$, there are only finitely many places $P$ of $F/K$ whose valuation ring $\mathcal{O}_P$ does not contain $x$, that is, $x$ has only finitely many poles. See [Stichtenoth, Corollary 1.3.4].
nodes.title: Finitely many poles

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a function field over a field $K$, that is, a finite extension of the rational function field $K(t)$. The genus $g$ of $F/K$ equals the dimension over $K$ of the quotient $\mathcal{A}_F / (\mathcal{A}_F(0) + F)$, where $\mathcal{A}_F$ is the adele ring, $\mathcal{A}_F(0)$ the integral adeles, and $F$ is embedded in $\mathcal{A}_F$ by the algebra map of the $F$-algebra structure on the adeles (stated…
nodes.title: Genus as the dimension of the adele class space

nodes.summary: For a function field $F$ over a field $K$, that is, a finite extension of the rational function field $K(t)$, the genus of $F/K$ is a natural number $g$, specified by the separately stated formula $g = \dim_K \mathcal{A}_F / (\mathcal{A}_F(0) + F)$, where $\mathcal{A}_F$ is the adele ring and $\mathcal{A}_F(0)$ the integral adeles. See [Stichtenoth, Corollary 1.5.5].
nodes.title: Genus of a function field

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a function field over a field $K$, that is, a finite extension of the rational function field $K(t)$. The algebra map $F \to \mathcal{A}_F$ of the $F$-algebra structure on the adele ring $\mathcal{A}_F$ equals the principal adele map $F \to \mathcal{A}_F$.
nodes.title: The adele algebra map is the principal embedding

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $K$ a field with $F$ a $K$-algebra. The integral adeles $\mathcal{A}_F(0)$ form the $K$-subspace of the adele ring $\mathcal{A}_F$ of $F/K$ consisting of the adeles $\alpha = (\alpha_P)_P$ whose coordinate $\alpha_P$ lies in the valuation ring $\mathcal{O}_P$ of $P$ for every place $P$ of $F/K$. See [Stichtenoth, Definition 1.5.3].
nodes.title: Integral adeles

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $K$ a field with $F$ a $K$-algebra. A place of $F/K$ is a valuation ring of $F$ containing $K$ and different from $F$: a $K$-subalgebra $\mathcal{O}$ of $F$ with $\mathcal{O} \neq F$ such that $z \in \mathcal{O}$ or $z^{-1} \in \mathcal{O}$ for every $z \in F$. See [Stichtenoth, Definition 1.1.4 and 1.1.8].
nodes.title: Place

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a function field over a field $K$, that is, a finite extension of the rational function field $K(t)$. For every $x \in F$ and every place $P$ of $F/K$, the coordinate at $P$ of the principal adele of $x$ is $x$.
nodes.title: Coordinates of a principal adele

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a function field over a field $K$, that is, a finite extension of the rational function field $K(t)$. The principal adele map is a ring homomorphism from $F$ to the adele ring $\mathcal{A}_F$ of $F/K$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
